adapter.name: HRDecoder-DirectMultiscaleAdapter
adapter.GT: base original-formula Dice + .1 HRcrop Dice; private Dice + .25 ordinary all-valid BCE
adapter.KD: private only fixed GT-consistent train teacher T*, all-valid normalization; no moving student targets
adapter.readout: W48 F1-F4 project32/sum; RGB16+probability16; DW7-LN-e2 blocks64x2; zero64->64/pixelshuffle4
adapter.gradient_route: all four HRNet feature inputs and p0 detached; final=z0.float().detach()+r.float(); no private gradient into base
adapter.mask: Existing geometry-valid and ignore255 masking retained; not claiming every original training detail identical
adapter.initialization: fresh ImageNet W48 seed42; no warm task weights

aligned.name: HRDecoder-ClassBalancedCorrection

aligned.KD: base fixed GT-consistent teacher KL normalized by fullGTpositive/negative counts at .5*lambda_K; private fixed GT-consistent teacher fullGT positive/negative stratified KL at lambda_K; teacher input only during training
aligned.readout: W48 F1-F4 project32/sum; RGB/probability pixelunshuffle2->16 each at1/2; DW13-LN-e2 blocks64x2; zero64->16/pixelshuffle2
aligned.gradient_route: private feature/logit inputs detach; explicit base GT and base teacher KL train HRNet; private GT/KD cannot change base
aligned.mask: Existing geometry-valid and ignore255 masking retained; not claiming every original training detail identical
aligned.initialization: fresh ImageNet W48 seed42; no warm task weights

expert.name: HRDecoder-PrivateExpert
